Planet audit & handling evidence

Administrators, Support and Multihunters can read the staff planet audit. Filter by staff actor or planet to inspect committed changes. The audit explains who changed a field and when; it does not grant permission to edit that field.

Keep private investigation and ticket evidence in the authorised tools. Do not publish IP addresses, session details, passkeys or ticket contents in news or public personnel pages.

Player support operations

Ticket queue

Use Staff control panel → Support tickets to read and reply to player cases. Confirm the account and the reported issue before responding. Support may resolve the ticket workflow but cannot reset the round, grant ranks, edit planets, reveal keys or alter bank policy.

Escalation

Escalate gameplay configuration or account assignment to an Administrator. Send investigation cases to a Multihunter through the authorised staff process. A player without a planet should continue to colonial registration rather than receive a placeholder planet.

← Planet audit & handling evidenceFair-play investigations →
CHAPTER 4 / 9ALL CHAPTERS ↑

Fair-play investigations

Evidence tools

Use Multihunters for access logs, shared-IP review, fleet movement reports and pair analysis. A shared address or a single attack is an indicator to review, not proof of misconduct. Compare timing, repeated fleet outcomes and independent evidence.

Limits

Multihunters can inspect investigative data and the staff planet audit. They cannot change account roles, configuration, funds, planets or Owner passkeys. Escalate corrective account actions to an Administrator; preserve the evidence and context.

Administration & Havoc

Round setup configures the local round. Planet tools can unlock every research branch or add one of each construction to your current planet.

Havoc control board

Configure research levels, construction counts, resources, asteroids, base-fleet totals per class and minutes per tick. Apply to all immediately sets those values on every saved practice planet. Smaller tick intervals make the game faster. Class totals are distributed across each race’s ship types; active missions retain their fleets.

Reset to previous restores the state from before the most recent Havoc application, including resources, asteroids, fleets and gamespeed. The backup survives page reloads. It is a single-step undo.

Dummy alliance members

Signed-in game admins can select an unassigned dummy in Alliance → Members and add it to the alliance, or create a new dummy member. High Commander rank alone does not show this admin control. Administration → Planets also offers the alliance selector and Add Dummy Member.

Ten-ship race matrix

Enter ten quantities, one for each numbered ship row. The five race columns show the corresponding named ship. Apply to all gives every planet those amounts in its own race’s Base fleet, without spreading class totals across multiple types. Other fleet slots and active missions retain their ships.

Confirm and saved setups

Confirm setup validates all ten ship quantities and every target race before any game values change. A non-zero quantity without a matching racial ship blocks the entire application. Edits invalidate the confirmation. Each confirmation saves the full current Havoc form in this browser’s history; the latest five are retained, and a sixth replaces the oldest. Use Previous Havoc setups → Load setup, review, confirm and Apply to all. Loading does not alter planets.

Staff tools & publishing news

The portal Staff panel is restricted to game admins. Tabs separate round tools, user assignments, news articles and reset.

01

Compose

Choose one of five update categories, enter a title, synopsis and article text. Font controls format selected text.

02

Publish

Publishing creates a central database article and a permanent article link.

03

Edit / save

The staff-made article list sits below the editor. Edit loads the article and exposes Save changes; saving updates the same entry.

24h

Pinned news

New staff articles join portal News posts and the archive. For 24 hours a pin badge and highlighted border keep them prominent; afterwards their normal layout and date order return.

Reset

The confirmed round reset recreates planets and alliances and clears intel, scans, quests, rewards and game news. All buildings and research reset to zero. Tax and sharing preferences reset unchecked. The Leave unfolded menu preference is retained as an interface setting. Accounts and passwords remain.

Staff controlcenters

Admin Controlcenter

Staff control panel → Admin Controlcenter provides a unified Round & ticker workspace with one tick-interval setting and one manual-tick control, plus subpages for, Planet Editor, Stats Editor, Planet tools and Havoc. Legacy Planet Editor and Stats Editor links still open those subpages.

Alliance Controlcenter

Choose an alliance, then use Overview, Settings, Members, Ranks, Keyholders, Funds or Structures. Keyholders lists holder names and issuance/revocation status for staff without revealing personal keys. Settings separates name, description, recruitment message and MOTD. Members holds staff planet-to-alliance assignment and Owner-rank management. Ranks includes independent fleet-readiness and permanent-fleet-control permissions. Funds edits reserves, minimums and tax. Structures provides the advanced fortress, build queue and cooldown editor.

Member actions

Normal alliance pages retain actions granted to members, officers and Owners. Staff overrides are gathered in the Alliance Controlcenter. Personal Owner passkeys remain restricted to their own holder.

Multihunters

Raw access log and Multi are separate pages. Fleet movement review compares recorded attacks between two targets and flags patterns for staff review; it does not prove farming or automatically ban accounts. Support and Multihunter ranks can also read the separate Staff planet audit page.

Forums & achievements

Alliance Forums is members-only; Galaxy Forum is restricted to the current galaxy. Your own topic posts and replies count toward the corresponding achievement. Private forum content is cleared by a round reset.

Site management test features

The former News articles tab is Site management. It retains the news editor and adds centrally saved switches for Round history demonstration rounds and the simulated battle lab. Demonstration rounds are explicitly fictional and disappear automatically when a completed real round is archived. The normal battle calculator remains available when its separate test lab is disabled.

The public Staff personnel page and Round history are linked from the portal’s top menu. Staff information includes public account names, account IDs, roles and duties; passwords, sessions and internal audit evidence are not part of the public directory.

Account registry and personnel

Each account has a unique five-character, read-only account ID, visible in Account profile, the planetary command card and staff personnel cards. Internal relationship keys remain intact. Staff overview lists all administrators, support officers and fair-play investigators with their duties. Staff workspaces do not require a personal planet; account role permissions still apply. Saving round settings displays an inline timestamped confirmation in the staff workspace.

Round timing and reset

Staff control panel → Admin Controlcenter → Round & ticker contains the ticker controls. A new or reset game starts with the ticker stopped and the old scheduled start cleared. Start it manually or save a new future start time. This is a browser-practice ticker: it runs while the game is open and catches up at most 24 ticks after inactivity.

▶

Start / restart

A fresh interval is scheduled. A manual action can unlock the first-start or first-restart quest once.

Ⅱ

Pause

Automatic ticks freeze and interval progress stays still. Run one tick is an explicit manual action.

■

Stop

Stops automatic ticks and resets the displayed interval bar. The first stop has a one-time quest reward.

◷

Schedule

Choose a future local date/time and save. The game must be open when processing the schedule; automatically starting never unlocks ticker quests.

Time information

The header shows current tick, next-tick countdown, an interval progress bar, a local 24-hour clock and synchronized server UTC. Page load measures browser navigation time; Server RTT measures the full network round trip. These clocks do not mean the simulation runs as a server-authoritative ticker.

Game updates

Starts, pauses and stops confirm with a toast and prominent yellow/black entries in Recent signals and News Log. Toggle the Game updates category in the news filters.

Spacing Bank policy

Admin Controlcenter → Spacing Bank controls exchange tax, resource values, minimum reserves, transaction cap and per-player per-tick allowance. Only Administrators can change this policy. Starting reserves apply next round and default to 1,000,000 of each resource.

Changing policy advances the bank revision so stale quotes must be reviewed again. Policy changes are logged. Do not describe the bank as infinite: a trade must leave every relevant reserve at or above its configured minimum.

← Round timing and reset

Staff permission nodes & diagnostics

Account ranks contains a permission matrix for Support and Multihunter ranks. Only an Administrator edits this matrix or grants Administrator rank. Permissions are checked on each API request; changing a rank’s nodes does not require assigning a planet. Menu visibility follows the same nodes. Each permission save is audited and rejects stale revisions. Owner-key reveal requires Alliance Controlcenter. Advanced alliance directory, reserve and structure edits also require Admin Controlcenter.

Staff with the Diagnostics permission node can run and read stored system inspection reports without a planet. Open diagnostics to audit links, metadata, asset delivery and a sample of browser layouts. Findings distinguish errors, warnings and information; visual quality still needs human review. Reports preserve their release version and date and can be exported as JSON.
